# Free YouTube Tools Pro (freeyoutubetools.com)

> Comprehensive, 100% free web toolkit for YouTube creators, providing 55+ AI scriptwriting, SEO tag extraction, channel audit, thumbnail inspection, and revenue tools.

## Core Creator Tools

- [YouTube Tags Extractor](https://freeyoutubetools.com/tools/tag-extractor): Extract hidden competitor video tags and keywords to rank higher in YouTube search algorithms.
- [AI Video Script Writer](https://freeyoutubetools.com/tools/ai-script-writer): Generate complete high-retention video scripts with intro hooks, body points, and outro CTAs.
- [AI Viral Titles Generator](https://freeyoutubetools.com/tools/title-generator): Generate high-CTR, click-worthy video titles tailored for viral retention.
- [YouTube Thumbnail Downloader](https://freeyoutubetools.com/tools/thumbnail-downloader): Fetch 1280x720 HD and 4K MaxRes thumbnail artwork directly from any public YouTube video.
- [YouTube Money Calculator](https://freeyoutubetools.com/tools/youtube-money-calculator): Calculate estimated daily, monthly, and yearly AdSense earnings based on view counts and niche CPM.
- [Channel Audit & SEO Score](https://freeyoutubetools.com/tools/channel-audit): Audit channel metadata, upload cadence, tags, descriptions, and SEO health.
- [YouTube Monetization Checker](https://freeyoutubetools.com/tools/monetization-checker): Check if a YouTube channel is monetized and part of the YouTube Partner Program (YPP).
- [Subtitles & Transcript Downloader](https://freeyoutubetools.com/tools/subtitle-downloader): Extract multi-language transcripts and captions in SRT, VTT, or plain text.
- [All 55+ Creator Tools Directory](https://freeyoutubetools.com/tools): Full searchable directory of all tools across SEO, AI, Visual, Analytics, Calculators, and Productivity.
